title: Implement a scoped raw PackageReference candidate for IFX C1
goal: Preserve V3 package allow/deny precedence in a read-only V4 Pre candidate without claiming complete L3.4 or C1 coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: A hashed public-contract module applies exact V3 ring, allow and deny patterns to raw src csproj PackageReference elements with nonzero ring coverage.
Clean, deny, allow-list, missing-input, zero-match, malformed-input and unsafe-path fixtures assert deterministic evidence and TargetRoot invariance.
Formal Pre and Diff, isolated IFX package regression and unchanged published V4 Package hash pass.
No production Profile, bundle acceptance, installed composition or complete C1 claim is made.
